{Identifier}.title: Identifier
{Identifier}.description: Value that can be used in file related actions for selecting a file.

{IsFolder}.title: IsFolder
{IsFolder}.description: True when the item is a folder, false otherwise.

{Thumbnail}.title: Thumbnail
{Thumbnail}.description: URL to the thumbnails of the item in 3 different sizes, if available.

Small.title: Small
Small.description: URL to the small, highly compressed size thumbnail of the item, if available.

Medium.title: Medium
Medium.description: URL to the standard size thumbnail of the item, if available.

Large.title: Large
Large.description: URL to the largest size thumbnail of the item, if available.

{Link}.title: Link to item
{Link}.description: Link that can be used to get to the file or list item. Only people with permissions to the item will be able to open the link.

{Name}.title: Name
{Name}.description: File name of the item in document libraries, display name of the item in lists.

{FilenameWithExtension}.title: File name with extension
{FilenameWithExtension}.description: For libraries, returns file name including extension. For lists, returns the title property.

{Path}.title: Folder path
{Path}.description: Path to the folder the item is in, relative to the site address.

{FullPath}.title: Full Path
{FullPath}.description: Full path of an item or a folder or a file

{ModerationStatus}.title: Content approval status
{ModerationStatus}.description: The content approval status. It can be one of the following: Draft, Pending, Approved, or Rejected

{ModerationComment}.title: Comments associated with the content approval of this list item
{ModerationComment}.description: The comments associated with moderation of the list item.

{ContentType}.title: Content type
{ContentType}.description: Name of the Content type of the item.

{HasAttachments}.title: Has attachments
{HasAttachments}.description: Indicates the presence of attachments in the item.

{Attachments}.title: Attachments
{Attachments}.description: Never returns any data. Use Attachment endpoints to access item attachments.

{VersionNumber}.title: Version number
{VersionNumber}.description: The version number of the file or the list item.

{TriggerWindowStartToken}.title: Trigger Window Start Token
{TriggerWindowStartToken}.description: A token expressing the time of the last flow check. Use this if you want to check if one or more columns were modified since the last flow check.

{TriggerWindowEndToken}.title: Trigger Window End Token
{TriggerWindowEndToken}.description: A token expressing the time of the current flow check. Use this if you want to check if one or more columns were modified since the last flow check.
